        adapterPeer = runtimeScope:GetScript("ms-rig-adapter.lua")
    end
    if adapterPeer == nil or type(adapterPeer.GetRigControllerAdapter) ~= "function" then
        motionLogger:warnOnce("adapter-script-unavailable", "controller adapter script unavailable")
        return nil
    end
    local ok, adapter = pcall(adapterPeer.GetRigControllerAdapter)
    if not ok then
        motionLogger:warnOnce("adapter-contract-unavailable", "controller adapter contract unavailable")
        return nil
    end
    if adapter == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(adapter) ~= "table" then
        motionLogger:warnOnce("adapter-contract-invalid", "controller adapter contract must be a table")
        return nil
    end
    generatedControllerAdapter = adapter
    return generatedControllerAdapter
end

local function adapterHasMethod(methodName)
    local adapter = resolveAdapter()
    return adapter ~= nil and type(adapter[methodName]) == "function"
end

local function callAdapter(methodName, ...)
    local adapter = resolveAdapter()
    if adapter == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local fn = adapter[methodName]
    if type(fn) ~= "function" then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(fn, ...)
    if ok then
        return result
    end
    motionLogger:info("adapter call failed", methodName)
    return nil
end

local function syncHostFacts()
    hostRuntime.capability = capability
    hostRuntime.controlProfile = controlProfile
    hostRuntime.bindingMode = bindingMode
    hostRuntime.avatarResourcePath = avatarResourcePath
    hostRuntime.controllerResourcePath = controllerResourcePath
    hostRuntime.scriptFilePath = scriptFilePath
    hostRuntime.defaultMoveSpeed = defaultMoveSpeed
    hostRuntime.defaultRunSpeed = defaultRunSpeed
    hostRuntime.turnSpeed = turnSpeed
    hostRuntime.ascendSpeed = ascendSpeed
    hostRuntime.descendSpeed = descendSpeed
    hostRuntime.groundProbeDistance = groundProbeDistance
    hostRuntime.groundProbeUpDistance = groundProbeUpDistance
    hostRuntime.groundContactOffset = groundContactOffset
end

local function syncAdapterFacts()
    local adapter = resolveAdapter()
    if adapter == nil then
        hostRuntime.adapterIdentifier = nil
        hostRuntime.adapterDefaultMoveMode = "idle"
        hostRuntime.adapterHasMountedGlue = false
        hostRuntime.adapterHasNeutralIdleGlue = false
        hostRuntime.adapterProfileSupported = true
        hostRuntime.adapterSupportedControlProfiles = nil
        return
    end

    hostRuntime.adapterIdentifier = adapter.IDENTIFIER or adapter.CONTROLLER_NAME or adapter.controllerName or "unknown"
    hostRuntime.adapterDefaultMoveMode = adapter.DEFAULT_MOVE_MODE or "idle"
    hostRuntime.adapterHasMountedGlue = adapterHasMethod("OnMountedInput") or adapterHasMethod("ApplyMountedLocomotion")
    hostRuntime.adapterHasNeutralIdleGlue =
        adapterHasMethod("ApplyNeutralIdleDefaults") or adapterHasMethod("ApplyDefaults")
    hostRuntime.adapterSupportedControlProfiles = adapter.SUPPORTED_CONTROL_PROFILES
    hostRuntime.adapterProfileSupported =
        type(adapter.SUPPORTED_CONTROL_PROFILES) ~= "table" or
        table.concat(adapter.SUPPORTED_CONTROL_PROFILES, ","):find(controlProfile, 1, true) ~= nil

    if not hostRuntime.adapterProfileSupported then
        motionLogger:warnOnce(
            "adapter-profile-unsupported",
            "adapter " ..
                tostring(hostRuntime.adapterIdentifier) ..
                    " does not declare support for controlProfile=" .. tostring(controlProfile)
        )
    end

    motionLogger:info(
        "adapter facts: identifier=" ..
            tostring(hostRuntime.adapterIdentifier) ..
                ", defaultMoveMode=" ..
                    tostring(hostRuntime.adapterDefaultMoveMode) .. ", profile=" .. tostring(controlProfile)
    )
end

local function resolveMountedIdleMode()
    local adapterMode = hostRuntime.adapterDefaultMoveMode
    if adapterMode ~= nil and adapterMode ~= "" then
        return tostring(adapterMode)
    end
    return "idle"
end

local function clearMountedIntents()
    hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode = resolveMountedIdleMode()
    hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent = 0
    hostRuntime.mountedTurnIntent = 0
    hostRuntime.mountedJumpIntent = false
    hostRuntime.mountedVerticalIntent = 0
end

local function resolveRootGameObject()
    if hostRuntime.rootGameObject ~= nil then
        return hostRuntime.rootGameObject
    end
    if self == nil or self.gameObject == nil or self.gameObject.transform == nil then
        return nil
    end

    hostRuntime.rootGameObject = self.gameObject
    return hostRuntime.rootGameObject
end

local function applyBindingFacts()
    local rootGameObject = resolveRootGameObject()
    if rootGameObject == nil then
        motionLogger:warnOnce("root-gameobject-missing", "Root GameObject is missing; animator binding skipped.")
        return
    end

    hostRuntime.animator = rootGameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Animator))
    if hostRuntime.animator == nil then
        hostRuntime.animator = rootGameObject:AddComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Animator))
        motionLogger:warn("Animator component was missing on root GameObject and has been added automatically by host binding.")
    end

    hostRuntime.animator.cullingMode = UnityEngine.AnimatorCullingMode.CullUpdateTransforms
    hostRuntime.animator.applyRootMotion = false

    local hasAvatar = hostRuntime.animator.avatar ~= nil
    local hasController = hostRuntime.animator.runtimeAnimatorController ~= nil

    if bindingMode == "controller_avatar" and hasAvatar and hasController then
        return
    end

    if bindingMode == "avatar_only" and hasAvatar then
        return
    end

    if bindingMode == "controller_avatar" then
        if not hasAvatar then
            local avatar = loadTypedResource(avatarResourcePath, typeof(UnityEngine.Avatar))
            if avatar ~= nil then
                hostRuntime.animator.avatar = avatar
            end
        end
        if not hasController then
            local controller = loadTypedResource(controllerResourcePath, typeof(UnityEngine.RuntimeAnimatorController))
            if controller ~= nil then
                hostRuntime.animator.runtimeAnimatorController = controller
            end
        end
        return
    end

    if bindingMode == "avatar_only" then
        if not hasAvatar then
            local avatar = loadTypedResource(avatarResourcePath, typeof(UnityEngine.Avatar))
            if avatar ~= nil then
                hostRuntime.animator.avatar = avatar
            end
        end
    end
end

local groundPeer = nil

local function resolveGroundPeer()
    if groundPeer ~= nil then

    if runtimeScope == nil then

    local peer, reason = runtimeScope:GetScript("ms-rig-grounding.lua")

        peer == nil or type(peer.EnforceRigRigidbodySettings) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.EnsureRigFacingCalibration) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.GetRigHorizontalForward) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.RotateRigHorizontal) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.ResolveRigGroundedPose) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.ApplyRigGroundAlignedRotation) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.RefreshRigMountedGrounding) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.RefreshRigUnmountedGrounding) ~= "function" or

     then

end

local function ensureFacingCalibration(root, forceRefresh)
    return callGround("EnsureRigFacingCalibration", root, forceRefresh)
end

local function enforceMountedRigidBodySettings()
    return callGround("EnforceRigRigidbodySettings")
end

local function resolveGroundedPose(root, candidatePosition, deltaTime, forceResetOffset, immediateSnap, shouldWarnOnMiss)
    local peer = resolveGroundPeer()
    if peer == nil then
        return candidatePosition, nil
    end
    return peer.ResolveRigGroundedPose(
        hostRuntime,
        root,
        candidatePosition,
        deltaTime,
        forceResetOffset,
        immediateSnap,
        shouldWarnOnMiss
    )

local function applyGroundAlignedRotation(root, targetNormal, deltaTime)

end

    return callGround("RefreshRigMountedGrounding", forceResetOffset) == true

local function resolveForwardIntent()
    if math.abs(hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent) > 0.0001 then
        return hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent
    end

    if hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode == "run" or hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode == "walk" then

    return 0

    if type(methodNames) ~= "table" then

    for i = 1, #methodNames do
        local methodName = methodNames[i]
        if adapterHasMethod(methodName) then

end

local function appendStateCandidate(candidates, stateName)

    for i = 1, #candidates do

    candidates[#candidates + 1] = stateName

    local group = snapshot.stateGroups[groupName]

            "ResetTriggerDeathGoToFall",
            "ResetTriggerRevive",
            "ResetTriggerGetHit",
            "ResetTriggerGetHitFront",
            "ResetTriggerGetHitLeft",
            "ResetTriggerGetHitRight",
            "ResetTriggerGlide",
            "ResetTriggerTakeOffGrounded",
            "ResetTriggerTakeOffBranch",
            "ResetTriggerLandingGrounded",
            "ResetTriggerLandingBranch"
        },
        self,
        hostRuntime
    )
end

local function tryCrossFadeAdapterStates(stateNames, visualStateKey)
    if hostRuntime.visualStateKey == visualStateKey then
        return true
    end
    if type(stateNames) ~= "table" then
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #stateNames do
        local stateName = stateNames[i]
        if type(stateName) == "string" and stateName ~= "" then
            local ok = callAdapter("CrossFadeState", self, hostRuntime, stateName, 0.15, 0)
            if ok == true then
                hostRuntime.visualStateKey = visualStateKey
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function tryCrossFadeAdapterSnapshotIdleState(visualStateKey)
    local snapshot = callAdapter("GetAnimatorSnapshot", hostRuntime)
    local candidates = {}

    appendSnapshotStateGroupCandidates(candidates, snapshot, "idle")
    appendSnapshotStateGroupCandidates(candidates, snapshot, "grounded_idle")
    appendSnapshotStateGroupCandidates(candidates, snapshot, "groundedIdle")
    appendSnapshotStateGroupCandidates(candidates, snapshot, "neutralIdle")

    if #candidates == 0 then
        return false
    end

    return tryCrossFadeAdapterStates(candidates, visualStateKey)
end

local function applyGroundedIdleVisualState()
    if hostRuntime.visualStateKey == "grounded_idle" then
        return true
    end

    resetNeutralIdleTriggers()

    if tryCrossFadeAdapterSnapshotIdleState("grounded_idle") then
        return true
    end

    local idlePulseResult =
        tryAdapterMethodList(
        {
            "PulseTriggerIdleLookAroundGrounded",
            "PulseTriggerIdleStretchWingsGrounded",
            "PulseTriggerIdleLookStretchLegsGrounded",
            "PulseTriggerIdleStareBranch",
            "PulseTriggerIdleLookAroundBranch",
            "PulseTriggerIdleStretchWingsBranch",
            "PulseTriggeridleFlapWings"
        },
        self,
        hostRuntime
    )
    if idlePulseResult ~= nil then
        hostRuntime.visualStateKey = "grounded_idle"
        return true
    end

    return tryCrossFadeAdapterStates(
        {
            "IdleStareGrounded",
            "IdleLookAroundGrounded",
            "IdleStretchWingsGrounded",
            "IdleStareBranch",
            "IdleLookAroundBranch",
            "IdleStretchWingsBranch"
        },
        "grounded_idle"
    )
end

local function applyMountedFlightVisualState(airborneTransition)
    if airborneTransition and not hostRuntime.mountedTakeoffPlayed then
        tryAdapterMethodList(
            {
                "PulseTriggerTakeOffGrounded",
                "PulseTriggerTakeOffBranch"
            },
            self,
            hostRuntime
        )
        hostRuntime.mountedTakeoffPlayed = true
    end

    local flightPulseResult =
        tryAdapterMethodList(
        {
            "PulseTriggerGlide"
        },
        self,
        hostRuntime
    )
    if flightPulseResult ~= nil then
        hostRuntime.visualStateKey = "mounted_flight"
        return
    end

    tryCrossFadeAdapterStates(
        {
            "Fly",
            "Glide"
        },
        "mounted_flight"
    )
end

local function applyNeutralIdleDefaults()
    if not hostRuntime.adapterHasNeutralIdleGlue and resolveAdapter() ~= nil then
        motionLogger:warnOnce(
            "adapter-neutral-idle-missing",
            "adapter is missing neutral idle glue; host keeps fallback idle state"
        )
    end
    local adapterIdleApplied = callAdapter("ApplyNeutralIdleDefaults", self, hostRuntime)
    if adapterCallSucceeded(adapterIdleApplied) then
        if applyGroundedIdleVisualState() ~= true then
            hostRuntime.visualStateKey = "grounded_idle"
        end
        return true
    end

    local adapterDefaultsApplied = callAdapter("ApplyDefaults", self, hostRuntime)
    if adapterCallSucceeded(adapterDefaultsApplied) then
        if applyGroundedIdleVisualState() ~= true then
            hostRuntime.visualStateKey = "grounded_idle"
        end
        return true
    end

    return applyGroundedIdleVisualState()
end

local function ensureNeutralIdleBootstrap()
    if hostRuntime.isMounted or hostRuntime.visualStateKey == "grounded_idle" then
        return
    end
    applyBindingFacts()
    applyNeutralIdleDefaults()
end

local function updateMountedMotion(dt)
    if not hostRuntime.isMounted then
        return
    end
    if not hostRuntime.adapterHasMountedGlue and resolveAdapter() ~= nil then
        motionLogger:warnOnce(
            "adapter-mounted-glue-missing",
            "adapter is missing mounted locomotion glue; mounted motion will stay host-minimal"
        )
    end

    local forwardIntent = resolveForwardIntent()
    local result =
        callAdapter(
        "OnMountedInput",
        self,
        hostRuntime,
        hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode,
        hostRuntime.mountedTurnIntent,
        forwardIntent,
        hostRuntime.mountedJumpIntent,
        hostRuntime.mountedVerticalIntent
    )

    if result == nil then
        result =
            callAdapter(
            "ApplyMountedLocomotion",
            self,
            hostRuntime,
            hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode,
            hostRuntime.mountedTurnIntent,
            forwardIntent,
            hostRuntime.mountedJumpIntent,
            hostRuntime.mountedVerticalIntent
        )
    end

    if result == nil and controlProfile ~= "land" then
        if controlProfile == "fish" then
            motionLogger:warnOnce(
                "fish-fallback",
                "fish profile is retaining fish semantics while reusing flying-style mounted locomotion glue"
            )
        end
        -- `flying` / `fish` vertical intent is still retained on the host even when
        -- the current adapter only consumes move/turn/forward.
        callAdapter(
            "ApplyMountedLocomotion",
            self,
            hostRuntime,
            hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode,
            hostRuntime.mountedTurnIntent,
            forwardIntent
        )
    end

    local currentTransform = self and self.transform or nil
    if currentTransform ~= nil and dt ~= nil and dt > 0 then
        ensureFacingCalibration(currentTransform, false)
        local turnValue = tonumber(hostRuntime.mountedTurnIntent) or 0
        local yawDelta = turnValue * (hostRuntime.turnSpeed or turnSpeed or 0) * dt
        if math.abs(yawDelta) > 0.0001 then
            local euler = currentTransform.eulerAngles
            currentTransform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(euler.x, euler.y + yawDelta, euler.z)
            hostRuntime.facingForward =
                rotateHorizontal(hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(currentTransform), yawDelta)
        end

        local forwardValue = resolveForwardIntent()
        if controlProfile == "land" then
            enforceMountedRigidBodySettings()

            local moveSpeed = hostRuntime.defaultMoveSpeed or defaultMoveSpeed
            if hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode == "run" then
                moveSpeed = hostRuntime.defaultRunSpeed or defaultRunSpeed
            end
            if forwardValue < 0 then
                moveSpeed = moveSpeed * 0.6
            end

            local forwardDistance = forwardValue * moveSpeed * dt
            local currentPosition = currentTransform.position
            local horizontalForward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(currentTransform)
            local candidatePosition =
                Vector3(
                currentPosition.x + horizontalForward.x * forwardDistance,
                currentPosition.y,
                currentPosition.z + horizontalForward.z * forwardDistance
            )
            local shouldWarnOnMiss =
                math.abs(forwardDistance) > 0.0001 or math.abs(turnValue) > 0.0001 or hostRuntime.mountedJumpIntent
            local groundedPosition, groundHit =
                resolveGroundedPose(currentTransform, candidatePosition, dt, false, false, shouldWarnOnMiss)
            currentTransform.position = groundedPosition
            if groundHit ~= nil then
                applyGroundAlignedRotation(currentTransform, groundHit.normal, dt)
            end
        elseif controlProfile == "flying" or controlProfile == "fish" then
            local verticalDistance = 0
            local verticalIntent = tonumber(hostRuntime.mountedVerticalIntent) or 0
            if verticalIntent > 0 then
                verticalDistance = (hostRuntime.ascendSpeed or ascendSpeed) * math.min(verticalIntent, 1) * dt
            elseif verticalIntent < 0 then
                verticalDistance =
                    -(hostRuntime.descendSpeed or descendSpeed) * math.min(math.abs(verticalIntent), 1) * dt
            end

            local moveSpeed = hostRuntime.defaultMoveSpeed or defaultMoveSpeed
            local forwardDistance = forwardValue * moveSpeed * dt
            local descentBlockedByGround = false
            if math.abs(forwardDistance) > 0.0001 or math.abs(verticalDistance) > 0.0001 then
                local currentPosition = currentTransform.position
                local forward = currentTransform.forward
                local up = currentTransform.up
                local candidatePosition =
                    Vector3(
                    currentPosition.x + forward.x * forwardDistance + up.x * verticalDistance,
                    currentPosition.y + forward.y * forwardDistance + up.y * verticalDistance,
                    currentPosition.z + forward.z * forwardDistance + up.z * verticalDistance
                )
                candidatePosition, descentBlockedByGround =
                    clampMountedAirborneDescent(currentTransform, currentPosition, candidatePosition, verticalIntent)
                currentTransform.position = candidatePosition
            end

            local currentHeight = currentTransform.position.y
            local baseHeight = hostRuntime.mountedBaseHeight
            if baseHeight == nil then
                baseHeight = currentHeight
                hostRuntime.mountedBaseHeight = currentHeight
            end
            local effectiveVerticalIntent = verticalIntent
            if descentBlockedByGround and effectiveVerticalIntent < 0 then
                effectiveVerticalIntent = 0
            end
            local airborneNow =
                math.abs(effectiveVerticalIntent) > 0.08 or currentHeight > baseHeight + 0.18 or
                (hostRuntime.mountedAirborne and currentHeight > baseHeight + 0.05)
            if airborneNow then
                applyMountedFlightVisualState(not hostRuntime.mountedAirborne)
            elseif hostRuntime.mountedAirborne then
                tryAdapterMethodList(
                    {
                        "PulseTriggerLandingGrounded",
                        "PulseTriggerLandingBranch"
                    },
                    self,
                    hostRuntime
                )
                hostRuntime.visualStateKey = nil
                hostRuntime.mountedTakeoffPlayed = false
                applyGroundedIdleVisualState()
            end
            hostRuntime.mountedAirborne = airborneNow
        end
    end

    hostRuntime.mountedJumpIntent = false
end

local function updateAutonomousMotion(dt)
    if not hostRuntime.isMounted and controlProfile == "land" then
        refreshUnmountedGroundingInternal(dt)
    end
    if capability == "2" then
        ensureNeutralIdleBootstrap()
        return
    end
    if not hostRuntime.isMounted then
        ensureNeutralIdleBootstrap()
    end
    -- Workspace-specific autonomous branches may be appended later.
end

function GetRigControlProfile()
    return controlProfile
end

function SetMountedRider(actorOrNil)
    hostRuntime.mountedRider = actorOrNil
    hostRuntime.isMounted = actorOrNil ~= nil
    hostRuntime.visualStateKey = nil
    if hostRuntime.isMounted then
        hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode = resolveMountedIdleMode()
        hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent = 0
        hostRuntime.mountedBaseHeight = self ~= nil and self.transform ~= nil and self.transform.position.y or nil
        hostRuntime.mountedAirborne = false
        hostRuntime.mountedTakeoffPlayed = false
        ensureFacingCalibration(self and self.transform or nil, true)
    else
        clearMountedIntents()
        clearGroundingState()
        hostRuntime.mountedBaseHeight = nil
        hostRuntime.mountedGroundClearance = nil
        hostRuntime.mountedAirborne = false
        hostRuntime.mountedTakeoffPlayed = false
        applyNeutralIdleDefaults()
    end
    callAdapter("OnMountedStateChanged", self, hostRuntime, hostRuntime.isMounted, actorOrNil)
    if hostRuntime.isMounted then
        refreshMountedGroundingInternal(true)
    end
end

function ClearMountedRider()
    SetMountedRider(nil)
end

function SetMountedMoveIntent(forwardIntent, strafeIntent)
    hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent = tonumber(forwardIntent) or 0
    if math.abs(hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent) < 0.08 then
        hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode = "idle"
    elseif hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent > 0.75 then
        hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode = "run"
    elseif hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent > 0 then
        hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode = "walk"
    elseif hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent < 0 then
        hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode = "back"
    end
end

function SetMountedMoveMode(mode)
    if mode == nil or mode == "" then
        hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode = resolveMountedIdleMode()
        return
    end
    hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode = tostring(mode)
end

function SetMountedTurnIntent(turnValue)
    hostRuntime.mountedTurnIntent = tonumber(turnValue) or 0
end

function SetMountedJumpIntent(isPressedOrPulse)
    hostRuntime.mountedJumpIntent = isPressedOrPulse == true
end

function SetMountedVerticalIntent(intentValue)
    hostRuntime.mountedVerticalIntent = tonumber(intentValue) or 0
end

function RefreshMountedGrounding(forceResetOffset)
    return refreshMountedGroundingInternal(forceResetOffset == true)
end

function ClearMountedGroundingState()
    clearGroundingState()
end

function GetMountedRuntimeSnapshot()
    local adapterSnapshot = callAdapter("GetAnimatorSnapshot", hostRuntime)
    return {
        adapterDefaultMoveMode = hostRuntime.adapterDefaultMoveMode,
        adapterHasMountedGlue = hostRuntime.adapterHasMountedGlue,
        adapterHasNeutralIdleGlue = hostRuntime.adapterHasNeutralIdleGlue,
        adapterIdentifier = hostRuntime.adapterIdentifier,
        adapterProfileSupported = hostRuntime.adapterProfileSupported,
        adapterSupportedControlProfiles = hostRuntime.adapterSupportedControlProfiles,
        capability = hostRuntime.capability,
        controlProfile = hostRuntime.controlProfile,
        isMounted = hostRuntime.isMounted,
        mountedMoveMode = hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode,
        mountedForwardIntent = hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent,
        mountedTurnIntent = hostRuntime.mountedTurnIntent,
        mountedJumpIntent = hostRuntime.mountedJumpIntent,
        mountedVerticalIntent = hostRuntime.mountedVerticalIntent,
        adapterSnapshot = adapterSnapshot
    }
end

function Start()
    syncHostFacts()
    syncAdapterFacts()
    hostRuntime.rb = self.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Rigidbody))
    enforceMountedRigidBodySettings()
    applyBindingFacts()
    if scriptFilePath ~= nil and scriptFilePath ~= "" then
        motionLogger:info("scriptFile facts available", scriptFilePath)
    end
    callAdapter("BindHost", self, hostRuntime)
    callAdapter("OnHostStart", self, hostRuntime)
    if resolveAdapter() ~= nil then
        applyNeutralIdleDefaults()
    end
    ensureFacingCalibration(self and self.transform or nil, true)
    hostRuntime.hasStarted = true
    if controlProfile == "land" then
        refreshMountedGroundingInternal(true)
    end
end

function Update()
    local dt = Time.deltaTime
    enforceMountedRigidBodySettings()
    updateAutonomousMotion(dt)
    updateMountedMotion(dt)
    if not hostRuntime.isMounted then
        clearMountedIntents()
    end
end

function OnDisable()
    clearMountedIntents()
    callAdapter("OnHostStop", self, hostRuntime)
end

function OnDestroy()
    clearMountedIntents()
    callAdapter("OnHostStop", self, hostRuntime)
end

-- Workspace-specific extra logic may be appended below by the generating agent.

-- Shared mounted interaction template baseline.
-- Root interaction host: owns platform Seat callbacks, button state, input listeners, and motion handoff.
---@displayName 骑乘交互

---@start
---@var mountText:string="乘坐"
---@name 乘坐文案
---@desc 目标空闲时交互按钮显示的文案
---@group 交互
---@var dismountText:string="离开"
---@name 离开文案
---@desc 本地玩家乘坐目标时交互按钮显示的文案
---@group 交互
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于 meta.json 的初始触发范围等比放大
---@group 交互
---@end

-- Walk/run switching is coupled to the motion peer and stays an internal preset.
local RUN_THRESHOLD = 0.75

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Input = UnityEngine.Input
local KeyCode = UnityEngine.KeyCode
local DouyinInputService = CS.DouyinInputService
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")
Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)
local interactionLogger = Logger.create("animated-creature-interaction")
local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)

-- BEGIN TEMPLATE CONFIG
local DEAD_ZONE = 0.1
-- END TEMPLATE CONFIG

local localActor = nil
local interactorBtn = nil
local hasPassenger = false
local motionPeer = nil
local motionControlProfile = nil
local seatPeer = nil
local riderPeer = nil
local moveVec = UnityEngine.Vector2.zero
local ownershipPending = false

local onMoveInputStart = nil
local onMoveInputPerform = nil
local onMoveInputCancel = nil

local function ensureOwnership(action)
    if action == nil then
        return
    end

    if not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then
        return
    end

    if self:HasOwnership() then
        action()
        return
    end

    if ownershipPending then
        return
    end
    ownershipPending = true

    self:RequestOwnership(function(succeeded)
        ownershipPending = false
        if succeeded then
            action()
        end
    end)
end

local function setButtonText(btn, text)
    if btn == nil then
        return
    end
    local label = btn:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text), true)
    if label ~= nil then
        label.gameObject:SetActive(true)
        label.text = text
    end
end

local function refreshButtonText()
    if interactorBtn == nil then
        return
    end
    setButtonText(interactorBtn, hasPassenger and dismountText or mountText)
end

local function sameRootObject(a, b)
    if a == nil or b == nil or a.transform == nil or b.transform == nil then
        return false
    end
    return a.transform.root == b.transform.root
end

local function resolveSeatPeer()
    if seatPeer ~= nil then
        return seatPeer
    end
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        interactionLogger:warnOnce("seat-scope-unavailable", "rig seat scope unavailable", runtimeScopeReason)
        return nil
    end

    local peer, reason = runtimeScope:GetScript("pi-rig-seat.lua")
    if
        peer == nil or not sameRootObject(peer.self, self) or
            type(peer.ResolveRigMountHelpers) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.HasRigSeatTarget) ~= "function"
     then
        interactionLogger:warnOnce("seat-script-unavailable", "rig seat script unavailable", reason)
        return nil
    end
    seatPeer = peer
    return seatPeer
end

local function resolveRiderPeer()
    if riderPeer ~= nil then
        return riderPeer
    end
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local peer, reason = runtimeScope:GetScript("pi-rig-rider.lua")
    if
        peer == nil or not sameRootObject(peer.self, self) or
            type(peer.PrepareRigActorMount) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.ReleaseRigActorMount) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.SetRigActorColliderEnabled) ~= "function"
     then
        interactionLogger:warnOnce("rider-script-unavailable", "rig rider script unavailable", reason)
        return nil
    end
    riderPeer = peer
    return riderPeer
end

local function resolveMotionPeer()
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        interactionLogger:warnOnce("motion-scope-unavailable", "motion script scope unavailable", runtimeScopeReason)
        return nil
    end
    local motion, reason = runtimeScope:GetScript("ms-root.lua")
    if
        motion == nil or not sameRootObject(motion.self, self) or type(motion.GetRigControlProfile) ~= "function" or
            type(motion.SetMountedRider) ~= "function"
     then
        interactionLogger:warnOnce("motion-script-unavailable", "motion script unavailable or incompatible", reason)
        return nil
    end
    return motion
end

local function resolveMotionControlProfile()
    if motionControlProfile ~= nil then
        return motionControlProfile
    end
    if motionPeer == nil then
        motionPeer = resolveMotionPeer()
    end
    if motionPeer == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, profile = pcall(motionPeer.GetRigControlProfile)
    if not ok or (profile ~= "land" and profile ~= "flying" and profile ~= "fish") then
        interactionLogger:warnOnce(
            "motion-profile-unavailable",
            "motion control profile unavailable or incompatible",
            tostring(profile)
        )
        return nil
    end
    motionControlProfile = profile
    return motionControlProfile
end

local function hasSeatTarget()
    local profile = resolveMotionControlProfile()
    if profile == nil then
        return false
    end
    local peer = resolveSeatPeer()
    if peer == nil then
        return false
    end
    return peer.HasRigSeatTarget(profile) == true
end

local function callMotion(methodName, ...)
    if motionPeer == nil then
        motionPeer = resolveMotionPeer()
    end
    if motionPeer == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local fn = motionPeer[methodName]
    if type(fn) ~= "function" then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(fn, ...)
    if ok then
        return result
    end
    return nil
end

local function handoffMoveIntent()
    local forward = moveVec.y
    if math.abs(forward) < DEAD_ZONE then
        forward = 0
    end
    callMotion("SetMountedMoveIntent", forward, 0)
end

local function handoffMoveState()
    local moveMode = "idle"
    if moveVec.y <= -DEAD_ZONE then
        moveMode = "back"
    elseif moveVec.y >= DEAD_ZONE then
        moveMode = moveVec.y > RUN_THRESHOLD and "run" or "walk"
    end
    callMotion("SetMountedMoveMode", moveMode)
end

local function handoffTurnIntent()
    local x = moveVec.x
    if math.abs(x) < DEAD_ZONE then
        x = 0
    end
    callMotion("SetMountedTurnIntent", x)
end

local function handoffVerticalIntent()
    local profile = resolveMotionControlProfile()
    if profile ~= "flying" and profile ~= "fish" then
        callMotion("SetMountedVerticalIntent", 0)
        return
    end
    local verticalIntent = 0
    if Input.GetKey(KeyCode.E) then
        verticalIntent = verticalIntent + 1
    end
    if Input.GetKey(KeyCode.Q) then
        verticalIntent = verticalIntent - 1
    end
    callMotion("SetMountedVerticalIntent", verticalIntent)
end

local function handoffJumpIntent()
    -- Only grounded profiles expose jump from interaction; flying/fish use vertical intent instead.
    local shouldJump = resolveMotionControlProfile() == "land" and Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Space)
    callMotion("SetMountedJumpIntent", shouldJump)
end

function Start()
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        interactionLogger:warn("resource scope unavailable", runtimeScopeReason)
    end
    motionPeer = resolveMotionPeer()
    local profile = resolveMotionControlProfile()
    if profile ~= nil then
        local peer = resolveSeatPeer()
        if peer ~= nil then
            peer.ResolveRigMountHelpers(profile)
        end
    end

    onMoveInputStart = function(vec)
        moveVec = vec
    end
    onMoveInputPerform = function(vec)
        moveVec = vec
    end
    onMoveInputCancel = function()
        moveVec = UnityEngine.Vector2.zero
    end

    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputStart:AddListener(onMoveInputStart)
    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputPerform:AddListener(onMoveInputPerform)
    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputCancel:AddListener(onMoveInputCancel)
end

function OnDestroy()
    if onMoveInputStart ~= nil then
        DouyinInputService.onMoveInputStart:RemoveListener(onMoveInputStart)
    end
    if onMoveInputPerform ~= nil then
        DouyinInputService.onMoveInputPerform:RemoveListener(onMoveInputPerform)
    end
    if onMoveInputCancel ~= nil then
        DouyinInputService.onMoveInputCancel:RemoveListener(onMoveInputCancel)
    end
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
    if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal or not hasSeatTarget() then
        return
    end
    localActor = actor
    self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
    if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal or hasPassenger then
        return
    end
    self:DisableInteraction()
end

function OnFocus(handType)
    interactorBtn = self:AddInteractorButton()
    refreshButtonText()
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
    if interactorBtn ~= nil then
        self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactorBtn)
        interactorBtn = nil
    end
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
    if index ~= 1 or localActor == nil then
        return
    end
    ensureOwnership(function()
        if hasPassenger then
            localActor:StandUp(self.gameObject)
        else
            localActor:SitDown(self.gameObject)
        end
    end)
end

function OnSeatEntered(actor, handType)
    if actor == nil then
        return
    end
    local peer = nil
    if hasSeatTarget() then
        peer = resolveRiderPeer()
    end
    if peer == nil or peer.PrepareRigActorMount(actor) ~= true then
        if actor.isLocal then
            hasPassenger = false
            refreshButtonText()
        end
        return
    end

    if actor.isLocal then
        hasPassenger = true
    end
    motionPeer = resolveMotionPeer()
    callMotion("SetMountedRider", actor)
    if resolveMotionControlProfile() == "land" then
        callMotion("RefreshMountedGrounding", true)
    end
    if actor.isLocal then
        refreshButtonText()
    end
end

function OnSeatExited(actor)
    if actor == nil then
        return
    end
    local peer = resolveRiderPeer()
    if peer ~= nil then

-- Shared mounted interaction template baseline.
-- Root interaction host: owns platform Seat callbacks, button state, input listeners, and motion handoff.
---@displayName 骑乘交互

---@start
---@var mountText:string="乘坐"
---@name 乘坐文案
---@desc 目标空闲时交互按钮显示的文案
---@group 交互
---@var dismountText:string="离开"
---@name 离开文案
---@desc 本地玩家乘坐目标时交互按钮显示的文案
---@group 交互
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于 meta.json 的初始触发范围等比放大
---@group 交互
---@end

-- Walk/run switching is coupled to the motion peer and stays an internal preset.
local RUN_THRESHOLD = 0.75

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Input = UnityEngine.Input
local KeyCode = UnityEngine.KeyCode
local DouyinInputService = CS.DouyinInputService
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")
Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)
local interactionLogger = Logger.create("animated-creature-interaction")
local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)

-- BEGIN TEMPLATE CONFIG
local DEAD_ZONE = 0.1
-- END TEMPLATE CONFIG

local localActor = nil
local interactorBtn = nil
local hasPassenger = false
local motionPeer = nil
local motionControlProfile = nil
local seatPeer = nil
local riderPeer = nil
local moveVec = UnityEngine.Vector2.zero
local ownershipPending = false

local onMoveInputStart = nil
local onMoveInputPerform = nil
local onMoveInputCancel = nil

local function ensureOwnership(action)
    if action == nil then
        return
    end

    if not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then
        return
    end

    if self:HasOwnership() then
        action()
        return
    end

    if ownershipPending then
        return
    end
    ownershipPending = true

    self:RequestOwnership(function(succeeded)
        ownershipPending = false
        if succeeded then
            action()
        end
    end)
end

local function setButtonText(btn, text)
    if btn == nil then
        return
    end
    local label = btn:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text), true)
    if label ~= nil then
        label.gameObject:SetActive(true)
        label.text = text
    end
end

local function refreshButtonText()
    if interactorBtn == nil then
        return
    end
    setButtonText(interactorBtn, hasPassenger and dismountText or mountText)
end

local function sameRootObject(a, b)
    if a == nil or b == nil or a.transform == nil or b.transform == nil then
        return false
    end
    return a.transform.root == b.transform.root
end

local function resolveSeatPeer()
    if seatPeer ~= nil then
        return seatPeer
    end
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        interactionLogger:warnOnce("seat-scope-unavailable", "rig seat scope unavailable", runtimeScopeReason)
        return nil
    end

    local peer, reason = runtimeScope:GetScript("pi-rig-seat.lua")
    if
        peer == nil or not sameRootObject(peer.self, self) or
            type(peer.ResolveRigMountHelpers) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.HasRigSeatTarget) ~= "function"
     then
        interactionLogger:warnOnce("seat-script-unavailable", "rig seat script unavailable", reason)
        return nil
    end
    seatPeer = peer
    return seatPeer
end

local function resolveRiderPeer()
    if riderPeer ~= nil then
        return riderPeer
    end
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local peer, reason = runtimeScope:GetScript("pi-rig-rider.lua")
    if
        peer == nil or not sameRootObject(peer.self, self) or
            type(peer.PrepareRigActorMount) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.ReleaseRigActorMount) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.SetRigActorColliderEnabled) ~= "function"
     then
        interactionLogger:warnOnce("rider-script-unavailable", "rig rider script unavailable", reason)
        return nil
    end
    riderPeer = peer
    return riderPeer
end

local function resolveMotionPeer()
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        interactionLogger:warnOnce("motion-scope-unavailable", "motion script scope unavailable", runtimeScopeReason)
        return nil
    end
    local motion, reason = runtimeScope:GetScript("ms-root.lua")
    if
        motion == nil or not sameRootObject(motion.self, self) or type(motion.GetRigControlProfile) ~= "function" or
            type(motion.SetMountedRider) ~= "function"
     then
        interactionLogger:warnOnce("motion-script-unavailable", "motion script unavailable or incompatible", reason)
        return nil
    end
    return motion
end

local function resolveMotionControlProfile()
    if motionControlProfile ~= nil then
        return motionControlProfile
    end
    if motionPeer == nil then
        motionPeer = resolveMotionPeer()
    end
    if motionPeer == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, profile = pcall(motionPeer.GetRigControlProfile)
    if not ok or (profile ~= "land" and profile ~= "flying" and profile ~= "fish") then
        interactionLogger:warnOnce(
            "motion-profile-unavailable",
            "motion control profile unavailable or incompatible",
            tostring(profile)
        )
        return nil
    end
    motionControlProfile = profile
    return motionControlProfile
end

local function hasSeatTarget()
    local profile = resolveMotionControlProfile()
    if profile == nil then
        return false
    end
    local peer = resolveSeatPeer()
    if peer == nil then
        return false
    end
    return peer.HasRigSeatTarget(profile) == true
end

local function callMotion(methodName, ...)
    if motionPeer == nil then
        motionPeer = resolveMotionPeer()
    end
    if motionPeer == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local fn = motionPeer[methodName]
    if type(fn) ~= "function" then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(fn, ...)
    if ok then
        return result
    end
    return nil
end

local function handoffMoveIntent()
    local forward = moveVec.y
    if math.abs(forward) < DEAD_ZONE then
        forward = 0
    end
    callMotion("SetMountedMoveIntent", forward, 0)
end

local function handoffMoveState()
    local moveMode = "idle"
    if moveVec.y <= -DEAD_ZONE then
        moveMode = "back"
    elseif moveVec.y >= DEAD_ZONE then
        moveMode = moveVec.y > RUN_THRESHOLD and "run" or "walk"
    end
    callMotion("SetMountedMoveMode", moveMode)
end

local function handoffTurnIntent()
    local x = moveVec.x
    if math.abs(x) < DEAD_ZONE then
        x = 0
    end
    callMotion("SetMountedTurnIntent", x)
end

local function handoffVerticalIntent()
    local profile = resolveMotionControlProfile()
    if profile ~= "flying" and profile ~= "fish" then
        callMotion("SetMountedVerticalIntent", 0)
        return
    end
    local verticalIntent = 0
    if Input.GetKey(KeyCode.E) then
        verticalIntent = verticalIntent + 1
    end
    if Input.GetKey(KeyCode.Q) then
        verticalIntent = verticalIntent - 1
    end
    callMotion("SetMountedVerticalIntent", verticalIntent)
end

local function handoffJumpIntent()
    -- Only grounded profiles expose jump from interaction; flying/fish use vertical intent instead.
    local shouldJump = resolveMotionControlProfile() == "land" and Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Space)
    callMotion("SetMountedJumpIntent", shouldJump)
end

function Start()
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        interactionLogger:warn("resource scope unavailable", runtimeScopeReason)
    end
    motionPeer = resolveMotionPeer()
    local profile = resolveMotionControlProfile()
    if profile ~= nil then
        local peer = resolveSeatPeer()
        if peer ~= nil then
            peer.ResolveRigMountHelpers(profile)
        end
    end

    onMoveInputStart = function(vec)
        moveVec = vec
    end
    onMoveInputPerform = function(vec)
        moveVec = vec
    end
    onMoveInputCancel = function()
        moveVec = UnityEngine.Vector2.zero
    end

    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputStart:AddListener(onMoveInputStart)
    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputPerform:AddListener(onMoveInputPerform)
    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputCancel:AddListener(onMoveInputCancel)
end

function OnDestroy()
    if onMoveInputStart ~= nil then
        DouyinInputService.onMoveInputStart:RemoveListener(onMoveInputStart)
    end
    if onMoveInputPerform ~= nil then
        DouyinInputService.onMoveInputPerform:RemoveListener(onMoveInputPerform)
    end
    if onMoveInputCancel ~= nil then
        DouyinInputService.onMoveInputCancel:RemoveListener(onMoveInputCancel)
    end
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
    if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal or not hasSeatTarget() then
        return
    end
    localActor = actor
    self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
    if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal or hasPassenger then
        return
    end
    self:DisableInteraction()
end

function OnFocus(handType)
    interactorBtn = self:AddInteractorButton()
    refreshButtonText()
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
    if interactorBtn ~= nil then
        self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactorBtn)
        interactorBtn = nil
    end
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
    if index ~= 1 or localActor == nil then
        return
    end
    ensureOwnership(function()
        if hasPassenger then
            localActor:StandUp(self.gameObject)
        else
            localActor:SitDown(self.gameObject)
        end
    end)
end

function OnSeatEntered(actor, handType)
    if actor == nil then
        return
    end
    local peer = nil
    if hasSeatTarget() then
        peer = resolveRiderPeer()
    end
    if peer == nil or peer.PrepareRigActorMount(actor) ~= true then
        if actor.isLocal then
            hasPassenger = false
            refreshButtonText()
        end
        return
    end

    if actor.isLocal then
        hasPassenger = true
    end
    motionPeer = resolveMotionPeer()
    callMotion("SetMountedRider", actor)
    if resolveMotionControlProfile() == "land" then
        callMotion("RefreshMountedGrounding", true)
    end
    if actor.isLocal then
        refreshButtonText()
    end
end

function OnSeatExited(actor)
    if actor == nil then
        return
    end
    local peer = resolveRiderPeer()
    if peer ~= nil then
        peer.ReleaseRigActorMount(actor)
    end
    if actor.isLocal then
        hasPassenger = false
        moveVec = UnityEngine.Vector2.zero
    end
    callMotion("ClearMountedRider")
    callMotion("ClearMountedGroundingState")
    callMotion("SetMountedVerticalIntent", 0)
    -- Restore collision only after the rider has left the creature volume and motion no longer treats it as mounted.
    if peer ~= nil then
        peer.SetRigActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)
    end
    if actor.isLocal then
        refreshButtonText()
    end
end

function Update()
    if not hasPassenger then
        return
    end
    handoffMoveIntent()
    handoffMoveState()
    handoffTurnIntent()
    handoffJumpIntent()
    handoffVerticalIntent()
end

-- Shared mounted interaction template baseline.
-- Root interaction host: owns platform Seat callbacks, button state, input listeners, and motion handoff.
---@displayName 骑乘交互

---@start
---@var mountText:string="乘坐"
---@name 乘坐文案
---@desc 目标空闲时交互按钮显示的文案
---@group 交互

---@name 离开文案
---@desc 本地玩家乘坐目标时交互按钮显示的文案
---@group 交互
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于 meta.json 的初始触发范围等比放大
---@group 交互
---@end

-- Walk/run switching is coupled to the motion peer and stays an internal preset.
local RUN_THRESHOLD = 0.75

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Input = UnityEngine.Input
local KeyCode = UnityEngine.KeyCode
local DouyinInputService = CS.DouyinInputService
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")
Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)
local interactionLogger = Logger.create("animated-creature-interaction")
local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)

-- BEGIN TEMPLATE CONFIG
local DEAD_ZONE = 0.1
-- END TEMPLATE CONFIG

local localActor = nil
local interactorBtn = nil
local hasPassenger = false
local motionPeer = nil
local motionControlProfile = nil
local seatPeer = nil
local riderPeer = nil
local moveVec = UnityEngine.Vector2.zero
local ownershipPending = false

local onMoveInputStart = nil
local onMoveInputPerform = nil
local onMoveInputCancel = nil

local function ensureOwnership(action)
    if action == nil then
        return
    end

    if not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then
        return
    end

    if self:HasOwnership() then
        action()
        return
    end

    if ownershipPending then
        return
    end
    ownershipPending = true

    self:RequestOwnership(function(succeeded)
        ownershipPending = false
        if succeeded then
            action()
        end
    end)
end

local function setButtonText(btn, text)
    if btn == nil then
        return
    end
    local label = btn:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text), true)
    if label ~= nil then
        label.gameObject:SetActive(true)
        label.text = text
    end
end

local function refreshButtonText()
    if interactorBtn == nil then
        return
    end
    setButtonText(interactorBtn, hasPassenger and dismountText or mountText)
end

local function sameRootObject(a, b)
    if a == nil or b == nil or a.transform == nil or b.transform == nil then
        return false
    end
    return a.transform.root == b.transform.root
end

local function resolveSeatPeer()
    if seatPeer ~= nil then
        return seatPeer
    end
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        interactionLogger:warnOnce("seat-scope-unavailable", "rig seat scope unavailable", runtimeScopeReason)
        return nil
    end

    local peer, reason = runtimeScope:GetScript("pi-rig-seat.lua")
    if
        peer == nil or not sameRootObject(peer.self, self) or
            type(peer.ResolveRigMountHelpers) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.HasRigSeatTarget) ~= "function"
     then
        interactionLogger:warnOnce("seat-script-unavailable", "rig seat script unavailable", reason)
        return nil
    end
    seatPeer = peer
    return seatPeer
end

local function resolveRiderPeer()
    if riderPeer ~= nil then
        return riderPeer
    end
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local peer, reason = runtimeScope:GetScript("pi-rig-rider.lua")
    if
        peer == nil or not sameRootObject(peer.self, self) or
            type(peer.PrepareRigActorMount) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.ReleaseRigActorMount) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.SetRigActorColliderEnabled) ~= "function"
     then
        interactionLogger:warnOnce("rider-script-unavailable", "rig rider script unavailable", reason)
        return nil
    end
    riderPeer = peer
    return riderPeer
end

local function resolveMotionPeer()
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        interactionLogger:warnOnce("motion-scope-unavailable", "motion script scope unavailable", runtimeScopeReason)
        return nil
    end
    local motion, reason = runtimeScope:GetScript("ms-root.lua")
    if
        motion == nil or not sameRootObject(motion.self, self) or type(motion.GetRigControlProfile) ~= "function" or
            type(motion.SetMountedRider) ~= "function"
     then
        interactionLogger:warnOnce("motion-script-unavailable", "motion script unavailable or incompatible", reason)
        return nil
    end
    return motion
end

local function resolveMotionControlProfile()
    if motionControlProfile ~= nil then
        return motionControlProfile
    end
    if motionPeer == nil then
        motionPeer = resolveMotionPeer()
    end
    if motionPeer == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, profile = pcall(motionPeer.GetRigControlProfile)
    if not ok or (profile ~= "land" and profile ~= "flying" and profile ~= "fish") then
        interactionLogger:warnOnce(
            "motion-profile-unavailable",
            "motion control profile unavailable or incompatible",
            tostring(profile)
        )
        return nil
    end
    motionControlProfile = profile
    return motionControlProfile
end

local function hasSeatTarget()
    local profile = resolveMotionControlProfile()
    if profile == nil then
        return false
    end
    local peer = resolveSeatPeer()
    if peer == nil then
        return false
    end
    return peer.HasRigSeatTarget(profile) == true
end

local function callMotion(methodName, ...)
    if motionPeer == nil then
        motionPeer = resolveMotionPeer()
    end
    if motionPeer == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local fn = motionPeer[methodName]
    if type(fn) ~= "function" then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(fn, ...)
    if ok then
        return result
    end
    return nil
end

local function handoffMoveIntent()
    local forward = moveVec.y
    if math.abs(forward) < DEAD_ZONE then
        forward = 0
    end
    callMotion("SetMountedMoveIntent", forward, 0)
end

local function handoffMoveState()
    local moveMode = "idle"
    if moveVec.y <= -DEAD_ZONE then
        moveMode = "back"
    elseif moveVec.y >= DEAD_ZONE then
        moveMode = moveVec.y > RUN_THRESHOLD and "run" or "walk"
    end
    callMotion("SetMountedMoveMode", moveMode)
end

local function handoffTurnIntent()
    local x = moveVec.x
    if math.abs(x) < DEAD_ZONE then
        x = 0
    end
    callMotion("SetMountedTurnIntent", x)
end

local function handoffVerticalIntent()
    local profile = resolveMotionControlProfile()
    if profile ~= "flying" and profile ~= "fish" then
        callMotion("SetMountedVerticalIntent", 0)
        return
    end
    local verticalIntent = 0
    if Input.GetKey(KeyCode.E) then
        verticalIntent = verticalIntent + 1
    end
    if Input.GetKey(KeyCode.Q) then
        verticalIntent = verticalIntent - 1
    end
    callMotion("SetMountedVerticalIntent", verticalIntent)
end

local function handoffJumpIntent()
    -- Only grounded profiles expose jump from interaction; flying/fish use vertical intent instead.
    local shouldJump = resolveMotionControlProfile() == "land" and Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Space)
    callMotion("SetMountedJumpIntent", shouldJump)
end

function Start()
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        interactionLogger:warn("resource scope unavailable", runtimeScopeReason)
    end
    motionPeer = resolveMotionPeer()
    local profile = resolveMotionControlProfile()
    if profile ~= nil then
        local peer = resolveSeatPeer()
        if peer ~= nil then
            peer.ResolveRigMountHelpers(profile)
        end
    end

    onMoveInputStart = function(vec)
        moveVec = vec
    end
    onMoveInputPerform = function(vec)
        moveVec = vec
    end
    onMoveInputCancel = function()
        moveVec = UnityEngine.Vector2.zero
    end

    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputStart:AddListener(onMoveInputStart)
    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputPerform:AddListener(onMoveInputPerform)
    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputCancel:AddListener(onMoveInputCancel)
end

function OnDestroy()
    if onMoveInputStart ~= nil then
        DouyinInputService.onMoveInputStart:RemoveListener(onMoveInputStart)
    end
    if onMoveInputPerform ~= nil then
        DouyinInputService.onMoveInputPerform:RemoveListener(onMoveInputPerform)
    end
    if onMoveInputCancel ~= nil then
        DouyinInputService.onMoveInputCancel:RemoveListener(onMoveInputCancel)
    end
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
    if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal or not hasSeatTarget() then
        return
    end
    localActor = actor
    self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
    if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal or hasPassenger then
        return
    end
    self:DisableInteraction()
end

function OnFocus(handType)
    interactorBtn = self:AddInteractorButton()
    refreshButtonText()
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
    if interactorBtn ~= nil then
        self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactorBtn)
        interactorBtn = nil
    end
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
    if index ~= 1 or localActor == nil then
        return
    end
    ensureOwnership(function()
        if hasPassenger then
            localActor:StandUp(self.gameObject)
        else
            localActor:SitDown(self.gameObject)
        end
    end)
end

function OnSeatEntered(actor, handType)
    if actor == nil then
        return
    end
    local peer = nil
    if hasSeatTarget() then
        peer = resolveRiderPeer()
    end
    if peer == nil or peer.PrepareRigActorMount(actor) ~= true then
        if actor.isLocal then
            hasPassenger = false
            refreshButtonText()
        end
        return
    end

    if actor.isLocal then
        hasPassenger = true
    end
    motionPeer = resolveMotionPeer()
    callMotion("SetMountedRider", actor)
    if resolveMotionControlProfile() == "land" then
        callMotion("RefreshMountedGrounding", true)
    end
    if actor.isLocal then
        refreshButtonText()
    end
end

function OnSeatExited(actor)
    if actor == nil then
        return
    end
    local peer = resolveRiderPeer()
    if peer ~= nil then
        peer.ReleaseRigActorMount(actor)
    end
    if actor.isLocal then
        hasPassenger = false
        moveVec = UnityEngine.Vector2.zero
    end
    callMotion("ClearMountedRider")
    callMotion("ClearMountedGroundingState")
    callMotion("SetMountedVerticalIntent", 0)
    -- Restore collision only after the rider has left the creature volume and motion no longer treats it as mounted.
    if peer ~= nil then
        peer.SetRigActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)
    end
    if actor.isLocal then
        refreshButtonText()
    end
end

function Update()
    if not hasPassenger then
        return
    end
    handoffMoveIntent()
    handoffMoveState()
    handoffTurnIntent()
    handoffJumpIntent()
    handoffVerticalIntent()
end

input.content:
-- Pull the local camera back while the local player is riding this horse.
---@displayName 骑乘镜头
---@start
---@var RideCameraDistance:number=7.5
---@name 骑乘镜头距离
---@desc 骑乘时相机与角色的距离，越大越靠后
---@group 镜头
---@var RideCameraPitch:number=14
---@name 骑乘镜头俯角
---@desc 骑乘时相机向下观察的角度
---@group 镜头
---@var RideCameraOffsetY:number=1.15
---@name 骑乘镜头高度
---@desc 骑乘时相机观察目标点向上偏移的高度
---@group 镜头
---@end

local DouyinCameraService = CS.DouyinCameraService
local Vector3 = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3

-- The platform has no getters for distance/offset, so keep the conventional
-- third-person defaults here and restore them explicitly when riding ends.
local defaultDistance = 4
local defaultPitch = 0
local defaultOffset = Vector3(0, 0, 0)
local isRiding = false

local function applyRideView()
    DouyinCameraService.SetDistance(RideCameraDistance)
    DouyinCameraService.SetPitch(RideCameraPitch)
    DouyinCameraService.SetOffset(Vector3(0, RideCameraOffsetY, 0))
end

local function restoreDefaultView()
    DouyinCameraService.SetDistance(defaultDistance)
    DouyinCameraService.SetPitch(defaultPitch)
    DouyinCameraService.SetOffset(defaultOffset)
end

function Start()
    local currentPitch = DouyinCameraService.GetPitch()
    if currentPitch ~= nil then
        defaultPitch = currentPitch
    end
end

function OnSeatEntered(actor)
    if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
        return
    end
    isRiding = true
    applyRideView()
end

function OnSeatExited(actor)
    if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
        return
    end
    isRiding = false
    restoreDefaultView()
end

function OnDisable()
    if isRiding then
        isRiding = false
        restoreDefaultView()
    end
end

function OnDestroy()
    if isRiding then
        isRiding = false
        restoreDefaultView()
    end
end

-- Shared rig Seat companion for mounted interaction.
-- Owns seat discovery, fallback alignment, anatomical orientation, and renderer-bound queries.
---@displayName 骑乘座位

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Vector3 = UnityEngine.Vector3
local Quaternion = UnityEngine.Quaternion
local Physics = UnityEngine.Physics
local GameObject = UnityEngine.GameObject
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local seatLogger = Logger.create("animated-creature-interaction/rig-seat")
local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)
local resourceRoot = runtimeScope ~= nil and runtimeScope:GetResourceRoot() or nil

-- BEGIN TEMPLATE CONFIG
local seatTargetPath = "rig/SK_Zebra/root/ZEBRA_/ZEBRA_ Pelvis/ZEBRA_ Spine/ZEBRA_ Spine1/SaddlePad/SeatAnchor"
local standUpTargetPath = nil
-- END TEMPLATE CONFIG

local FACING_MISMATCH_ANGLE_THRESHOLD = 20.0
local SEAT_FALLBACK_FORWARD_RATIO = 2 / 5
local SEAT_FALLBACK_BOTTOM_MARGIN_RATIO = 0.1
local SEAT_FALLBACK_TOP_SAFE_BAND_RATIO = 0.22
local SEAT_FALLBACK_PROBE_HEIGHT = 0.25
local SEAT_FALLBACK_SURFACE_LIFT = 0.08
local SEAT_EMBEDDED_SURFACE_DELTA_RATIO = 0.05
local SEAT_EMBEDDED_SURFACE_DELTA_MIN = 0.08

local seatAnchor = nil
local seatTrans = nil
local standUpAnchor = nil
local seatRuntimeFallback = nil
local hasFacingMismatch = false
local facingOffsetDegrees = 0.0
local cachedAnatomicalForward = nil
local seatControlProfile = nil

local function usesBackSurfaceFallback()
    return seatControlProfile == "flying" or seatControlProfile == "fish"
end

local function setSeatControlProfile(profile)
    if profile ~= "land" and profile ~= "flying" and profile ~= "fish" then
        seatLogger:warnOnce("control-profile-unavailable", "rig seat control profile unavailable", tostring(profile))
        return false
    end
    seatControlProfile = profile
    return true
end

local function clamp(value, minValue, maxValue)
    if value < minValue then
        return minValue
    end
    if value > maxValue then
        return maxValue
    end
    return value
end

local function arrayAt(values, index)
    if values == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local direct = values[index]
    if direct ~= nil then
        return direct
    end
    if type(values.GetValue) == "function" then
        local ok, value =
            pcall(
            function()
                return values:GetValue(index)
            end
        )
        if ok then
            return value
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function getCombinedRendererBounds(root)
    if root == nil or root.gameObject == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local renderers = root.gameObject:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Renderer), true)
    if renderers == nil or renderers.Length == nil or renderers.Length <= 0 then
        return nil
    end

    local bounds = nil
    for i = 0, renderers.Length - 1 do
        local renderer = arrayAt(renderers, i)
        if renderer ~= nil then
            if bounds == nil then
                bounds = renderer.bounds
            else
                bounds:Encapsulate(renderer.bounds)
            end
        end
    end
    return bounds
end

local function getHorizontalForward(root)
    local forward = root and root.forward or Vector3.forward
    local horizontal = Vector3(forward.x, 0, forward.z)
    if horizontal.sqrMagnitude == nil or horizontal.sqrMagnitude < 0.0001 then
        return Vector3.forward
    end
    return horizontal.normalized
end

local function findFirstByNameToken(parent, token)
    if parent == nil or token == nil or token == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local lowerToken = string.lower(token)
    local selfName = string.lower(tostring(parent.name or ""))
    if string.find(selfName, lowerToken, 1, true) ~= nil then
        return parent
    end
    for i = 0, parent.childCount - 1 do
        local child = parent:GetChild(i)
        if child ~= nil then
            local found = findFirstByNameToken(child, token)
            if found ~= nil then
                return found
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function findPelvisLikeNode(root)
    if root == nil then
        return nil
    end
    return findFirstByNameToken(root, "pelvis")
end

local function findHeadLikeNode(root)
    if root == nil then
        return nil
    end
    return findFirstByNameToken(root, "head")
end

local function getAnatomicalForward(root)
    if root == nil then
        return Vector3.forward
    end
    local pelvis = findPelvisLikeNode(root)
    local head = findHeadLikeNode(root)
    if pelvis ~= nil and head ~= nil and pelvis.position ~= nil and head.position ~= nil then
        local forward = Vector3(head.position.x - pelvis.position.x, 0, head.position.z - pelvis.position.z)
        if forward.sqrMagnitude ~= nil and forward.sqrMagnitude >= 0.0001 then
            return forward.normalized
        end
    end
    return getHorizontalForward(root)
end

local function getCreatureUp(root)
    local up = root and root.up or Vector3.up
    if up.sqrMagnitude == nil or up.sqrMagnitude < 0.0001 then
        return Vector3.up
    end
    return up.normalized
end

local function signedYawDegrees(fromVec, toVec)
    local from = Vector3(fromVec.x, 0, fromVec.z)
    local to = Vector3(toVec.x, 0, toVec.z)
    if from.sqrMagnitude == nil or from.sqrMagnitude < 0.0001 then
        from = Vector3.forward
    else
        from = from.normalized
    end
    if to.sqrMagnitude == nil or to.sqrMagnitude < 0.0001 then
        to = Vector3.forward
    else
        to = to.normalized
    end
    local cross = from.x * to.z - from.z * to.x
    local dot = clamp(from.x * to.x + from.z * to.z, -1.0, 1.0)
    local angleRadians = nil
    local ok, result =
        pcall(
        function()
            return math.atan(cross, dot)
        end
    )
    if ok then
        angleRadians = result
    else
        angleRadians = math.atan(cross / math.max(math.abs(dot), 0.0001))
        if dot < 0 then
            if cross >= 0 then
                angleRadians = angleRadians + math.pi
            else
                angleRadians = angleRadians - math.pi
            end
        end
    end
    return math.deg(angleRadians)
end

local function ensureFacingMismatchState(root)
    if root == nil then
        hasFacingMismatch = false
        facingOffsetDegrees = 0.0
        cachedAnatomicalForward = Vector3.forward
        return false
    end
    local anatomicalForward = getAnatomicalForward(root)
    local rootForward = getHorizontalForward(root)
    local mismatchAngle = signedYawDegrees(rootForward, anatomicalForward)
    facingOffsetDegrees = mismatchAngle
    cachedAnatomicalForward = anatomicalForward
    hasFacingMismatch = math.abs(mismatchAngle) >= FACING_MISMATCH_ANGLE_THRESHOLD
    return hasFacingMismatch
end

local function getBoundsExtentAlongDirection(bounds, direction)
    local dir = direction.normalized
    local extents = bounds.extents
    return math.abs(dir.x) * extents.x + math.abs(dir.y) * extents.y + math.abs(dir.z) * extents.z
end

local function buildSeatFallbackReferencePoint(root, bounds, pelvis)
    if root == nil or bounds == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local forward = cachedAnatomicalForward or getAnatomicalForward(root)
    local up = getCreatureUp(root)
    local probeBase = bounds.center
    if pelvis ~= nil and pelvis.position ~= nil then
        probeBase = pelvis.position
    end

    local forwardExtent = getBoundsExtentAlongDirection(bounds, forward)
    local upExtent = getBoundsExtentAlongDirection(bounds, up)
    local directionScale = 1
    if usesBackSurfaceFallback() then
        directionScale = -1
    end
    local forwardOffset = forwardExtent * SEAT_FALLBACK_FORWARD_RATIO * directionScale
    local upOffset = math.max(SEAT_FALLBACK_SURFACE_LIFT, upExtent * 0.14)
    return Vector3(
        probeBase.x + forward.x * forwardOffset + up.x * upOffset,
        probeBase.y + forward.y * forwardOffset + up.y * upOffset,
        probeBase.z + forward.z * forwardOffset + up.z * upOffset
    )
end

local function isSeatReferenceInsideBounds(bounds, point)
    if bounds == nil or point == nil then
        return false
    end
    local sizeY = bounds.size.y
    local bottomMargin = math.max(0.05, sizeY * SEAT_FALLBACK_BOTTOM_MARGIN_RATIO)
    local topSafeBand = math.max(0.18, sizeY * SEAT_FALLBACK_TOP_SAFE_BAND_RATIO)
    return point.x >= bounds.min.x and point.x <= bounds.max.x and point.z >= bounds.min.z and point.z <= bounds.max.z and
        point.y >= bounds.min.y + bottomMargin and
        point.y <= bounds.max.y - topSafeBand
end

local function isSeatReferenceEmbedded(bounds, point, surfacePoint)
    if not isSeatReferenceInsideBounds(bounds, point) then
        return false
    end
    if surfacePoint == nil then
        return true
    end
    local maxSurfaceDelta = math.max(SEAT_EMBEDDED_SURFACE_DELTA_MIN, bounds.size.y * SEAT_EMBEDDED_SURFACE_DELTA_RATIO)
    return (surfacePoint.y - point.y) > maxSurfaceDelta
end

local function tryFindSeatSurfaceHit(root, bounds, pelvis)
    if root == nil or bounds == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local referencePoint = buildSeatFallbackReferencePoint(root, bounds, pelvis)
    if referencePoint == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local origin = Vector3(referencePoint.x, referencePoint.y + SEAT_FALLBACK_PROBE_HEIGHT, referencePoint.z)
    local maxDistance = bounds.size.y + SEAT_FALLBACK_PROBE_HEIGHT * 2.0
    local hits = Physics.RaycastAll(origin, Vector3.down, maxDistance)
    if hits == nil or hits.Length == nil or hits.Length <= 0 then
        return referencePoint
    end

    local preferredHit = nil
    local preferredDistance = nil
    local triggerHit = nil
    local triggerDistance = nil
    for i = 0, hits.Length - 1 do
        local hit = arrayAt(hits, i)
        if
            hit ~= nil and hit.collider ~= nil and hit.collider.transform ~= nil and
                hit.collider.transform.root == root.root
         then
            local hitDistance = tonumber(hit.distance) or 0.0
            if hit.collider.isTrigger then
                if triggerHit == nil or hitDistance < triggerDistance then
                    triggerHit = hit
                    triggerDistance = hitDistance
                end
            else
                if preferredHit == nil or hitDistance < preferredDistance then
                    preferredHit = hit
                    preferredDistance = hitDistance
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local finalHit = preferredHit or triggerHit
    if finalHit == nil or finalHit.point == nil then
        return referencePoint
    end

    return Vector3(finalHit.point.x, finalHit.point.y + SEAT_FALLBACK_SURFACE_LIFT, finalHit.point.z)
end

local function ensureSeatRuntimeFallback(root)
    if root == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local fallbackParent = findPelvisLikeNode(root) or root
    if seatRuntimeFallback == nil then
        local go = GameObject("SeatRuntimeFallback")
        if go == nil then
            return nil
        end
        seatRuntimeFallback = go.transform
        seatRuntimeFallback:SetParent(fallbackParent)
    elseif seatRuntimeFallback.parent ~= fallbackParent then
        local worldPos = seatRuntimeFallback.position
        local worldRot = seatRuntimeFallback.rotation
        seatRuntimeFallback:SetParent(fallbackParent)
        seatRuntimeFallback.position = worldPos
        seatRuntimeFallback.rotation = worldRot
    end
    return seatRuntimeFallback
end

local function applySeatFallbackFromBounds(root)
    local bounds = getCombinedRendererBounds(root)
    if bounds == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local pelvis = findPelvisLikeNode(root)
    local fallback = ensureSeatRuntimeFallback(root)
    if fallback == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local candidate = tryFindSeatSurfaceHit(root, bounds, pelvis)
    fallback.position = candidate
    fallback.rotation = Quaternion.LookRotation(cachedAnatomicalForward or getAnatomicalForward(root), Vector3.up)
    return fallback
end

local function sampleSeatSurfaceAtWorldPoint(root, bounds, worldPoint)
    if root == nil or bounds == nil or worldPoint == nil or Physics == nil then
        return worldPoint
    end
    local origin = Vector3(worldPoint.x, bounds.max.y + SEAT_FALLBACK_PROBE_HEIGHT, worldPoint.z)
    local maxDistance = bounds.size.y + SEAT_FALLBACK_PROBE_HEIGHT * 2.0
    local hits = Physics.RaycastAll(origin, Vector3.down, maxDistance)
    if hits == nil or hits.Length == nil or hits.Length <= 0 then
        return worldPoint
    end

    local preferredHit = nil
    local preferredDistance = nil
    local triggerHit = nil
    local triggerDistance = nil
    for i = 0, hits.Length - 1 do
        local hit = arrayAt(hits, i)
        if
            hit ~= nil and hit.collider ~= nil and hit.collider.transform ~= nil and
                hit.collider.transform.root == root.root
         then
            local hitDistance = tonumber(hit.distance) or 0.0
            if hit.collider.isTrigger then
                if triggerHit == nil or hitDistance < triggerDistance then
                    triggerHit = hit
                    triggerDistance = hitDistance
                end
            else
                if preferredHit == nil or hitDistance < preferredDistance then
                    preferredHit = hit
                    preferredDistance = hitDistance
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local finalHit = preferredHit or triggerHit
    if finalHit == nil or finalHit.point == nil then
        return worldPoint
    end
    return Vector3(finalHit.point.x, finalHit.point.y + SEAT_FALLBACK_SURFACE_LIFT, finalHit.point.z)
end

local function projectPointToPlane(point, planeOrigin, planeNormal)
    if point == nil or planeOrigin == nil or planeNormal == nil then
        return point
    end
    local normal = planeNormal.normalized
    local toPoint = Vector3(point.x - planeOrigin.x, point.y - planeOrigin.y, point.z - planeOrigin.z)
    local distance = toPoint.x * normal.x + toPoint.y * normal.y + toPoint.z * normal.z
    return Vector3(point.x - normal.x * distance, point.y - normal.y * distance, point.z - normal.z * distance)
end

local function applySeatMidlineAdjustment(root, bounds)
    if not hasFacingMismatch or root == nil or bounds == nil or seatTrans == nil then
        return
    end
    local pelvis = findPelvisLikeNode(root)
    if pelvis == nil or pelvis.position == nil then
        return
    end
    local forward = cachedAnatomicalForward or getAnatomicalForward(root)
    local up = getCreatureUp(root)
    local planeNormal = Vector3.Cross(forward, up)
    if planeNormal.sqrMagnitude == nil or planeNormal.sqrMagnitude < 0.0001 then
        return
    end
    local projected = projectPointToPlane(seatTrans.position, pelvis.position, planeNormal)
    local adjusted = sampleSeatSurfaceAtWorldPoint(root, bounds, projected)
    local seatPositionHost = seatTrans == seatRuntimeFallback and seatTrans or (seatAnchor or seatTrans)
    if seatPositionHost ~= nil then
        seatPositionHost.position = adjusted
    end
end

local function alignSeatFacing(root, anchor, seat)
    if root == nil then
        return
    end
    local targetRotation = Quaternion.LookRotation(cachedAnatomicalForward or getAnatomicalForward(root), Vector3.up)
    if anchor ~= nil then
        anchor.rotation = targetRotation
    end
    if seat ~= nil then
        seat.rotation = targetRotation
    end
end

local function resolveMountHelpers()
    local root = resourceRoot ~= nil and resourceRoot.transform or nil
    if root == nil then
        seatLogger:warn("resource root unavailable; mount interaction disabled")
        return
    end

    ensureFacingMismatchState(root)
    local seatReason = nil
    seatAnchor, seatReason = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath(seatTargetPath)
    if seatAnchor == nil then
        seatLogger:warn("SeatAnchor missing; mount unavailable", "reason=" .. tostring(seatReason))
    else
        seatTrans = seatAnchor
    end

    local bounds = getCombinedRendererBounds(root)
    local seatReference = seatTrans or seatAnchor
    local sampledSeatSurface = nil
    if seatReference ~= nil and bounds ~= nil then
        sampledSeatSurface = sampleSeatSurfaceAtWorldPoint(root, bounds, seatReference.position)
    end
    if
        seatReference ~= nil and bounds ~= nil and
            isSeatReferenceEmbedded(bounds, seatReference.position, sampledSeatSurface)
     then
        local fallback = applySeatFallbackFromBounds(root)
        if fallback ~= nil then
            seatTrans = fallback
            if usesBackSurfaceFallback() then
                seatLogger:warn("SeatAnchor appears inside body; using pelvis-linked back-surface seat fallback")
            else
                seatLogger:warn("SeatAnchor appears inside body; using pelvis-linked forward-surface seat fallback")
            end
        end
    elseif seatTrans == nil then
        local fallback = applySeatFallbackFromBounds(root)
        if fallback ~= nil then
            seatTrans = fallback
            if usesBackSurfaceFallback() then
                seatLogger:warn("Seat helper missing or incomplete; using pelvis-linked back-surface seat fallback")
            else
                seatLogger:warn("Seat helper missing or incomplete; using pelvis-linked forward-surface seat fallback")
            end
        end
    end

    if bounds ~= nil then
        applySeatMidlineAdjustment(root, bounds)
    end

    alignSeatFacing(root, seatAnchor, seatTrans)

    if standUpTargetPath ~= nil and standUpTargetPath ~= "" then
        standUpAnchor = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath(standUpTargetPath)
    end
    if standUpAnchor == nil then
        seatLogger:info("StandUpAnchor missing; current world position will be kept on dismount")
    end
end

function ResolveRigMountHelpers(profile)
    if not setSeatControlProfile(profile) then
        return false
    end
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        seatLogger:warnOnce("scope-unavailable", "resource scope unavailable", runtimeScopeReason)
        return false
    end
    resolveMountHelpers()
    return seatTrans ~= nil
end

function HasRigSeatTarget(profile)
    if profile ~= nil and profile ~= seatControlProfile then
        return ResolveRigMountHelpers(profile)
    end
    if seatControlProfile == nil then
        return false
    end
    if seatTrans == nil then
        ResolveRigMountHelpers(seatControlProfile)
    end
    return seatTrans ~= nil
end

function GetRigSeatTarget()
    if not HasRigSeatTarget() then
        return nil
    end
    return seatTrans
end

function GetRigStandUpAnchor()
    if standUpAnchor == nil and standUpTargetPath ~= nil and standUpTargetPath ~= "" then
        standUpAnchor = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath(standUpTargetPath)
    end
    return standUpAnchor
end

function GetRigRootTransform()
    if resourceRoot ~= nil and resourceRoot.transform ~= nil then
        return resourceRoot.transform
    end
    return self ~= nil and self.transform or nil
end

function GetRigAnatomicalForward(root)
    return cachedAnatomicalForward or getAnatomicalForward(root)
end

function GetRigCombinedRendererBounds(root)
    return getCombinedRendererBounds(root)
end

function SampleRigSeatSurface(root, bounds, worldPoint)
    return sampleSeatSurfaceAtWorldPoint(root, bounds, worldPoint)
end
